name: Stripe Live Secret Key
description: Detects Stripe live secret API keys embedded in source code.
remediation: Remove the Stripe live secret key from client/source code, rotate it immediately, and keep Stripe secret keys only in a trusted server environment.

name: Stripe Test Secret Key
description: Detects Stripe test/sandbox secret API keys embedded in source code.
remediation: Remove the Stripe test secret key from client/source code, rotate it if exposed, and keep secret API keys only in a trusted server environment.

name: Stripe Restricted Secret Key
description: Detects Stripe restricted API keys embedded in source code.
remediation: Remove the Stripe restricted key from client/source code, rotate it if exposed, and keep restricted/secret keys in a trusted server environment.

name: GitHub Access Token
description: Detects common GitHub access-token formats embedded in source code.
remediation: Remove the GitHub token from source code, revoke/rotate it, and use a secret store or runtime credential injection.

name: GitLab Access/OAuth Token
description: Detects common GitLab credential prefixes embedded in source code.
remediation: Remove the GitLab credential from source code, revoke/rotate it, and store it in an appropriate secrets mechanism.

name: Slack Access/App Token
description: Detects Slack bot/user/app style tokens embedded in source code.
remediation: Remove the Slack token from source code, revoke/rotate it, and load it from a secure runtime secret source.

name: Private Key Material
pattern: -----BEGIN (?:(?:RSA|DSA|EC|OPENSSH) PRIVATE KEY|PRIVATE KEY|PGP PRIVATE KEY BLOCK)-----
remediation: Remove the private key from source code, rotate/reissue the key pair, and store private key material in platform-backed or server-side key management.

name: Database URI With Embedded Password
description: Detects database connection URIs containing embedded username/password credentials.
remediation: Remove database credentials from source code, rotate the password, and inject the connection secret at runtime from a trusted configuration/secrets system.

name: Supabase Secret API Key
description: Detects Supabase secret API keys intended for trusted backend environments.
remediation: Remove the Supabase secret key from client/source code, rotate it, and use it only from a trusted backend or secret manager.

name: Firebase Legacy FCM Server Key
description: Detects legacy Firebase Cloud Messaging server-key style credentials. Normal Firebase client API keys (AIza...) are intentionally not HSD findings.
remediation: Remove the legacy Firebase server credential from client/source code, rotate/replace it, and use the current server-side Firebase authentication mechanism.
